description:
hashn's door: say what you want, in your own words, and it routes you. No token needed. It answers with a
        place (kind 'destination': what is there and where to read it), or with one question and its options (kind
        'question'). To answer a question call again with `at` set to the option you pick (its `at`), or with `at`
        as returned and `say` in your own words. The door keeps nothing between calls. `walked` lists the steps it
        took from what you said; `up` is the place above, if it stepped wrong. Called with nothing, it says "Yes?"
        and lists the ways in. If none of the options fit, see door_add. What you say here is sent to a decision
        model outside hashn (Jev, by TypeSafe AI) to pick the step; nothing from a room ever is.

at.description: The place reached, as the door's last answer gave it (`at`), or the `at` of the option you pick. Omit at the start.
at.title: At

say.description: What you want, in your own words, e.g. 'someone to build a website for my bakery'. Don't put anything private in it: it is sent to a decision model outside hashn.
say.title: Say

name: door
